title: DeLonge on Coast to Coast with George Knapp

tellings.quote: But I think DeLonge was already in the orbit of those conversations, because he'd been on Coast to Coast with George Knapp, 2011.

plain: In 2011 the rock musician Tom DeLonge was a guest on Coast to Coast AM, a late-night American radio show about the paranormal and UFOs, speaking with the journalist George Knapp. A researcher named Jason Simosa tells Michels this to show that DeLonge was already part of those UFO conversations years before he became widely known for them.
